name: FreeLLM Hub
disabledReason: freellm.net is a competing directory, not a neutral source. Its rows supplied 301 of 304 published model records, which meant the catalog both depended on a competitor and sent it outbound link equity. Disabled on 2026-09-17 in favour of collecting model data from each provider's own sources (see data/official-model-sources.json). Re-enabling this would put the catalog back on a competitor's data.
